    Proposition 4.6: algebraic realizations for small index sets or small D_i #

    If the ordinal I has a countable cofinal subset, a recursive lift along a cofinal sequence extends every u ∈ D_i to a compatible family. If every D_i is finite-dimensional, extending evaluation at u to the direct limit of the dual spaces gives such a family. In both cases Theorem B gives an algebraic realization.
